seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: y x9, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring A1/A2 moves y+-6 carrying blocks that overlap the beam; blocks hit by the new ring/beam rects are chain-pushed.
Vertical move cancels if any moved block would leave the colour-4 field: that is the block A1 no_change (t38, blocks would reach y=1). No object field decides it.
A4/A3 change beam w by 6. A hooked next/collected block at beam end-5 drags the on-beam blocks; an unhooked extend pushes swept next/collected blocks; a blocked group leaves the beam moving alone.
Tags: a hooked next block with only collected blocks beside it on the beam becomes collected and the first todo in legend order becomes next; a collected block off the beam with no hook reverts. Its legend swatch centre is 0 while collected.
HUD row 53 gets 3s from x=63, (n-1)//3 for n non-click actions. n is hidden and continuity-gated (fallback 3*marks+1). Clicks are no-ops.
